messages.settings.cloud.title: Cloud configuration backup
messages.settings.cloud.description: By default, save general settings to your own cloud storage in encrypted form and restore them on other devices. Sensitive connection information such as API keys is included only after you explicitly consent for this operation. Wordbooks, chat history, and usage statistics are excluded.
messages.settings.cloud.unavailable: Cloud backup requires the extension background. Use a local backup file in this environment.
messages.settings.cloud.downloadDescription: Restore only what the {provider} backup contains within this operation’s scope. By default, keep this device’s keys and connection settings.
messages.settings.cloud.uploadDescription: Save this device’s settings to {provider} within the scope you consented to for this operation, replacing the current cloud backup. Sensitive information is excluded by default.
messages.settings.cloud.firstTitle: Save this device’s configuration to the cloud
messages.settings.cloud.selectedAccount: This sync uses your selected {provider} account.
messages.settings.cloud.connectionChanged: The sync connection changed. Generate a new preview.
messages.settings.cloud.scopeSettingsDescription: General settings such as language, appearance, shortcuts, and website rules will be synced.
messages.settings.cloud.includeSensitive: Include API keys and other sensitive information this time
messages.settings.cloud.sensitiveDescription: Keys, service credentials, authentication information, translation services, models, service URLs, custom request parameters, and private prompts.
messages.settings.cloud.consentOnce: You consented to syncing sensitive information for this operation. The option turns off again when the operation ends.
messages.settings.cloud.preserveLocal: Restoring or merging general settings keeps this device’s keys, translation services, and connection settings unchanged.
messages.settings.cloud.consentStorage: API keys and other sensitive information will be encrypted on this device and stored in {provider}.
messages.settings.cloud.consentRisk: The encryption passphrase is public, so anyone with the backup file may decrypt it. A compromised account or leaked backup can expose your API keys.
messages.settings.cloud.consentAdvice: We recommend syncing only general settings. If you need to migrate keys, protect your account and directory permissions, and avoid sharing backup files.
messages.settings.cloud.consentAcknowledgement: I understand the risk and agree to include sensitive information this time.
messages.settings.cloud.previewSensitive: Saving or merging will include this device’s sensitive information. Restoring applies only what the cloud backup actually contains.
messages.settings.cloud.legacySensitive: This cloud backup contains sensitive information. This restore applies only general settings and keeps this device’s connections. Sensitive information is removed from the current cloud file only after you confirm saving or merging general settings. Turning the option off does not delete old files or versions retained by the provider.
messages.settings.cloud.remoteSettingsOnly: This backup contains only general settings. Restoring keeps this device’s keys and connections. Saving or merging can add sensitive information within the scope you consented to for this operation.
messages.settings.webdav.passwordSaved: Saved; leave blank to keep it
messages.settings.webdav.passwordHint: Enter an app password for this service
messages.settings.webdav.connectionHint: Enter the full WebDAV URL of an existing directory. HTTPS and an app password are recommended. Connection settings stay on this device.
messages.settings.webdav.testSuccess: Connection test passed. No cloud files have been changed.
messages.settings.webdav.saveSuccess: Connection settings saved. You can start a cloud backup.
messages.settings.webdav.clearDescription: Clear the WebDAV URL, app password, and sync record on this device? Device configuration and cloud backup files will be kept.
messages.settings.webdav.httpWarning: HTTP does not encrypt network traffic. Others may read your connection credentials and backup.
messages.settings.webdav.httpConsent: I understand the risk and want to use this HTTP URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.trusted: WebDAV cloud backup is only available from the extension settings page.
messages.settings.webdav.error.action: Invalid action. Reopen settings and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.url: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS directory URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
messages.settings.webdav.error.credentials: Enter a valid username and app password. Enter the password again when changing the URL or username.
messages.settings.webdav.error.insecure: This URL uses HTTP. Acknowledge the unencrypted transport warning first.
messages.settings.webdav.error.missing: Set up the WebDAV server and app password first.
messages.settings.webdav.error.changed: Connection settings changed in another page. Reopen connection settings.
messages.settings.webdav.error.auth: The username or app password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.forbidden: The server denied access. Check the directory’s read and write permissions.
messages.settings.webdav.error.notFound: The directory does not exist. Enter an existing WebDAV directory URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.locked: Another device is using the backup file. Try again later.
messages.settings.webdav.error.quota: The server is out of storage space. Free space and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.conflict: The cloud backup changed. Generate a new preview.
messages.settings.webdav.error.etag: The server did not provide an ETag for safe updates. You can still restore an existing backup; use a service with conditional writes to save changes.
messages.settings.webdav.error.network: Cannot connect to the server. Check the URL, network, and certificate. If the URL redirects, enter the final WebDAV URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.timeout: The server timed out. Check your network and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.tooLarge: The backup file is too large. Use a local backup file.
messages.settings.webdav.error.invalidDav: This URL did not return a valid WebDAV directory. Check that WebDAV is enabled.
messages.settings.webdav.error.http: The server request failed (HTTP {status}). Check the service and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.encryptedOnly: Only encrypted configuration within the size limit can be uploaded.
messages.settings.webdav.error.verify: The uploaded backup could not be verified. Generate a new preview and try again. Device configuration was not replaced.
messages.settings.webdav.error.decrypt: The backup could not be decrypted or is damaged. Device configuration was not changed.
messages.settings.webdav.error.failure: The operation did not finish. Check the network and local storage and try again.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyEncryption: Configuration is encrypted before upload. The app passphrase is public; account, directory, and device security provide the main protection.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyWebDavStorage: Accesses only the FluentRead backup under your chosen server directory.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyWebDavConnection: The connection password stays on this device. Server access requires a manual action.
messages.settings.cloud.changed.credentials: API keys, OAuth tokens and authentication
messages.settings.cloud.fieldLabel.0: Show target language in context menu
messages.settings.cloud.cleanupPending: The operation completed, but its authorization cache could not be cleared. Reopening settings will retry.
messages.settings.cloud.versionMissing: The backup lacks a version identifier for safe replacement. You can still restore it; read it again before retrying.
messages.settings.cloud.verifyFailed: Cloud backup verification failed. Read the backup again before retrying; this device’s configuration was not changed.
messages.settings.cloud.restoreOnly: You can restore this backup, but the service has not provided a version identifier for safe replacement. Saving and merging are currently unavailable.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteDescription: This cloud backup cannot be restored after deletion.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteLocalPreserved: Local settings and API keys are kept.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteHistory: Only the current backup file is deleted. Clear provider trash, retained versions and copies on other devices separately.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteRecreate: A later manual sync can create a new backup. Other devices may also upload it again.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteUnsupported: The provider did not supply the version information required for safe deletion. This backup cannot be deleted here.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteManualDrive: Open Google Drive Settings → Manage apps → FluentRead to clear the application data.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteManualWebDav: In your WebDAV provider, delete FluentRead/fluentread-config.encrypted.json manually and keep other files in the folder.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteAbsentDescription: Nothing to delete. Finish to clear the old sync record.
messages.settings.cloud.deleteSuccess: Cloud backup deleted. Local settings kept.

legacy.普通云备份包含不属于此范围的字段，请重新生成备份。: The general-settings cloud backup contains fields outside its scope. Generate a new backup.
legacy.敏感信息同步选项必须为布尔值。: The sensitive-information sync option must be a boolean.
legacy.同步预览缺少敏感信息范围，请重新生成。: The sync preview is missing its sensitive-information scope. Generate a new preview.
legacy.同步预览范围已变化，请重新生成。: The sync preview’s scope has changed. Generate a new preview.
legacy.删除预览已失效，请重新检查云端备份。: The deletion preview expired. Check the cloud backup again.
legacy.删除目标账号或连接已变化，请重新检查云端备份。: The target account or connection changed. Check the cloud backup again.
legacy.云端备份已变化，请重新检查后再删除。: The cloud backup changed. Check it again before deleting.
legacy.云端备份缺少安全删除所需的版本信息，请到服务商管理页面手动删除。: The backup lacks the version information required for safe deletion. Delete it manually in the provider management page.
legacy.删除后仍检测到云端备份，可能已被其他设备重新创建，请重新检查。: A backup is still present after deletion. Another device may have recreated it. Check again.
legacy.删除预览属于其他页面或已失效，请在原设置页面继续。: This deletion preview belongs to another page or expired. Continue in the original settings page.
